action_notes: Recloser R1 tripped three times and locked out (SCADA). Fault isolated downstream of R1; upstream section 1 stayed energized.
Troubleshooter opened in-line disconnect D1 to separate mainline section 3 from the faulted section 2.
Closed normally-open tie switch PRD1201-TIE to back-feed mainline section 3 from feeder PRD1202 (load transfer).
Tree crew removed the limb; line crew spliced two phases and replaced the split crossarm on P-1201-114.
Closed R1 and verified voltage (section 2 and lateral 1 restored); opened the tie switch and closed D1 to return to the normal configuration.
Fuse F1 operated and isolated lateral 1.
